dailyBrief: Relativity Networks has secured $22 million in funding to develop a new type of fiber technology aimed at enhancing data center speeds, a move that could significantly impact cloud computing and data-intensive industries. Meanwhile, Y Combinator is increasing its focus on robotics and physical AI startups, signaling a potential shift in investment trends toward tangible applications of AI technology. In a related concern, recent lawsuits surrounding AI hiring tools highlight the growing scrutiny over discrimination and transparency, which could lead to stricter regulations in recruitment practices.
